# Explore qPCR data of Microcystis, microcystin genes, cyanotoxin data, and associated variables

## Set up

```{r}
#| label: load packages

library(tidyverse) #for readr, lubridate, ggplot2
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library(forcats)

```

## Import data

```{r}
#| label: read in Kurobe et al. 2022, a CHAB dataset from EDI

options(scipen = 999)

SFE_CHAB_2014_2019 <- read_csv(
  "molecular/qpcr/data/SFE_cyanoHAB_data_2014_2019_v1.csv",
  col_types = cols(
    RepCont = col_integer(),
    Collection_Month = col_integer(),
    Collection_ID = col_integer(),
    Survey_Year = col_integer(),
    field.PST = col_character(),  
    ucd.qpcr.total.MIC = col_integer(),
    ucd.qpcr.toxin.MIC = col_integer()
    )) |> 
  mutate(
    # create time (e.g., "08:30") from current values in field.PST
    field.PST = str_pad(field.PST, width = 4, side = "left", pad = "0"),
    field.PST = parse_time(str_replace(field.PST, "^(\\d{2})(\\d{2})$", "\\1:\\2"), format = "%H:%M")
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: create separate dataframes for controls and field samples

# controls are any row where DWR_site contains "FieldCont"
SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_controls <- SFE_CHAB_2014_2019 |> 
  filter(str_detect(DWR_Site, "FieldCont"))

# field samples are everything else
SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples <- SFE_CHAB_2014_2019 |> 
  filter(!str_detect(DWR_Site, "FieldCont") | is.na(DWR_Site))

```

```{r}
#| label: deal with replicate field samples

rep_keys <- SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples |> 
  filter(RepCont == 1) |> 
  distinct(Lat, Lon, Collection_Date)

replicates <- SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples |> 
  semi_join(rep_keys, by = c("Lat", "Lon", "Collection_Date")) |> 
  arrange(Collection_Date, Lat, Lon, RepCont)

replicates <- replicates |> 
  mutate(
    toxin_total_ratio = if_else(
      ucd.qpcr.total.MIC > 0,
      ucd.qpcr.toxin.MIC / ucd.qpcr.total.MIC,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .after = ucd.qpcr.toxin.MIC
  )

```

```{r}
#| label: plot replicate field samples for gene copy ratios

microcystin_data_explo_reps_ratio <-ggplot(replicates, aes(x = ucd.ppia.MC.total.ugL, 
                       y = toxin_total_ratio, 
                       color = factor(Collection_Date),
                       shape = factor(Collection_Date))) +
  geom_jitter(size = 6, width = 0.04, height = 0.04, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = rep(15:20, 3)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Toxin gene ratio (qPCR) vs. microcystin concentration (PPIA) for samples with 2 replicates",
       x = "Microcystin value from PPIA (µg/L)",
       y = "Ratio mcyD:16S (gene copies)",
       color = "Date",
       shape = "Date")

dir.create("molecular/qpcr/figures", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# save plot
save_plot(
  filename = "molecular/qpcr/figures/microcystin_data_explo_reps_ratio.png",
  plot = microcystin_data_explo_reps_ratio,
  base_height = 6,
  base_asp = 1.4,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```

```{r}
#| label: plot replicate field samples for total mcyD gene copies

microcystin_data_explo_reps_copies <- ggplot(replicates, aes(x = ucd.ppia.MC.total.ugL, 
                                                             y = ucd.qpcr.toxin.MIC, 
                                                             color = factor(Collection_Date),
                                                             shape = factor(Collection_Date))) +
  geom_jitter(size = 6, width = 0.04, height = 0, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    trans = pseudo_log_trans(sigma = 1, base = 10),
    breaks = c(0, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000),
    labels = label_comma()
  ) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = rep(15:20, 3)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()) +
  labs(title = "Toxin gene copies (qPCR) vs. microcystin concentration (PPIA) for samples with 2 replicates",
       x = "Microcystin concentration from PPIA (\u00b5g/L)",
       y = "mcyD toxin qPCR (gene copies, log10 scale)",
       color = "Date",
       shape = "Date")

# save plot
save_plot(
  filename = "molecular/qpcr/figures/microcystin_data_explo_reps_copies.png",
  plot = microcystin_data_explo_reps_copies,
  base_height = 6,
  base_asp = 1.4,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```

```{r}
#| label: create ratio for all samples

SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples <- SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples |> 
  mutate(
    toxin_total_ratio = if_else(
      ucd.qpcr.total.MIC > 0,
      ucd.qpcr.toxin.MIC / ucd.qpcr.total.MIC,
      NA_real_
    ),
    .after = ucd.qpcr.toxin.MIC
  )

# clean up the data
SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples_detects <- SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples |>
    #remove rows with zero values for ratio AND microcystin (keep if one value is zero)
    filter(toxin_total_ratio != 0 | ucd.ppia.MC.total.ugL != 0) |>
    #remove rows where copy number for either MIC16S or mycD is <100
    filter(ucd.qpcr.total.MIC >= 100 & ucd.qpcr.toxin.MIC >= 100)


```

```{r}
#| label: make similar plots for all samples

SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples_detects <- SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples_detects %>%
  mutate(
    Month_Year = paste(Collection_Month, Survey_Year),
    # order legend chronologically instead of alphabetically
    Month_Year = fct_reorder(Month_Year, as.Date(Collection_Date))
  )

# endless Month-Year combos
n_combos <- nlevels(SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples_detects$Month_Year)

# plot using Month_Year (instead of dates) for both color and shape
microcystin_data_explo_ratio <- ggplot(
  SFE_CHAB_2014_2019_samples_detects, 
  aes(x = ucd.ppia.MC.total.ugL, 
      y = toxin_total_ratio, 
      color = Month_Year,
      shape = Month_Year)
) +
  geom_jitter(size = 6, width = 0.04, height = 0.04, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = rep(15:20, length.out = n_combos)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(ncol = 2),
    shape = guide_legend(ncol = 2)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Toxin gene ratio (qPCR) vs. microcystin concentration (PPIA) for all samples",
    x = "Microcystin value from PPIA (µg/L)",
    y = "Ratio mcyD:16S (gene copies)",
    color = "Month & Year",
    shape = "Month & Year"
  )

# save plot
save_plot(
  filename = "molecular/qpcr/figures/microcystin_data_explo_ratio.png",
  plot = microcystin_data_explo_ratio,
  base_height = 6,
  base_asp = 2,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)

```
